artworks.title: Landscape with the Landing of Aeneas in Latium
artworks.description: Claude's coast: Aeneas' ships touch Latium — Virgil's Italian arrival staged as golden light on the Tiber shore.

artworks.title: Coast Scene with the Landing of Aeneas in Latium
artworks.description: Rijksmuseum engraving after Claude: the Trojan landing that opens the Italian war books — destiny stepping onto Latin soil.

artworks.title: Aeneas and Turnus
artworks.description: The final duel of Aeneid 12: Aeneas faces Turnus — the cost of founding Latium paid in the Rutulian king's blood.

artworks.title: The Fight between Aeneas and King Turnus
artworks.description: LACMA print from the Aeneid cycle: Aeneas and Turnus locked in combat — Rome's founding war as graphic epic.

music.title: Dido and Aeneas
music.description: Purcell's chamber opera ends as Aeneas sails for Italy — Dido's lament the price of the Trojan's Italian destiny.

popCulture.title: Aeneid
popCulture.creator: Virgil
popCulture.description: The Italian war books — Turnus, Lavinia, and the cost of founding Latium — remain Rome's national epic.

popCulture.title: Aeneas
popCulture.description: From Carthage's shore to the Tiber — Aeneas' Italian arrival is the myth Rome told about itself.
